verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search engine platform, so user-configurable background automations (scheduled jobs, triggers, autonomous workflows) are a fair axis, but the evidence documents none. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: automatic embedding generation and Meilisync's automatic database syncing are fixed background behaviors, and the MCP server is interactive natural-language control, not autonomous automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
